content:
I've been on a quest to find accessories that are extremely thin, work well with my everyday carry, and I have a deep appreciation for how tech companies and brands make their products so small and light. Bulky accessories, or those that lack a good storage design, usually aren't for me. So I've tried countless accessories — from power banks, stands, and magnetic cables, to all sorts of products. Below, I want to share some of my absolute favorite accessories that are not only ultra-thin and portable, but also incredibly versatile.

Be sure to check out our hands-on video, where I showcase every device mentioned in this article and introduce several more. The video highlights 11 thin and lightweight accessories worth noting.

This is a recent addition to my everyday carry, and it has been performing exceptionally well. The Snap Grip Stand is made by the same company that invented the original PopSockets. I'm genuinely amazed that something this thin can pack in so much functionality. It's basically as thick as the iPhone's camera plateau. Here are the main features:

  • Features a PopSocket-like ring for single- or two-finger grip
  • Comes with an independent, adjustable metal stand that rotates 350 degrees
  • Supports both portrait and landscape viewing
  • Double-sided magnetic design, allowing you to stack additional MagSafe accessories on top of the stand itself

I still can't fathom how they managed to cram this much functionality into something so thin and light, but it's now a permanent fixture on my iPhone. It's so thin that you can still wirelessly charge your phone while it's attached! Another really cool feature is that because it's so thin, it actually eliminates the wobble when your phone is placed on a flat surface.

The Snap Grip Stand retails for US$39.99 on its official website, and comes in four colors: black, green, lavender, and silver. They also offer a version with just the ring portion for US$29.99, available in 18 colors — way too many for me to list here. It's an easy recommendation for any iPhone user.

This has consistently been one of my favorite products. On the surface, it looks like just another three-in-one charging stand for Apple devices, but it's the build quality, versatility, and value that truly set it apart. You get:

  • MagSafe-compatible, Qi2.2 25W charging support
  • 5W Apple Watch charging
  • 5W AirPods charging
  • Foldable CNC aluminum design

This product is incredibly compact, slim, and lightweight. The Kuxiu X40 Turbo can be folded down to charge just your iPhone; unfolded, it becomes a three-in-one charging stand; and fully flattened, it can be used while lying flat. At its thinnest point, it's only 18mm, and when folded, it fits right in the palm of your hand. Best of all, it includes a 45W power adapter to support the 25W fast charging, and even comes with a hard-shell carrying case for all the accessories. This is a truly underrated device.

The Kuxiu X40 Turbo is available on the Kuxiu website for US$78, in five colors: gray, black, wood grain, orange, and cherry. The first charger to perfectly match the Cosmic Orange iPhone! At US$78, the bundle includes the charging stand, a braided cable, a 45W power adapter, and a carrying case.

Now we get to the more interesting stuff. I'm a huge proponent of extremely small, thin MagSafe power banks. Larger MagSafe batteries definitely have their use cases, but if I'm going to charge my phone while using it, I'd rather go with a smaller-capacity battery to give my phone some extra juice without turning it into a two-pound brick in my hand. The thinnest, lightest MagSafe power bank currently available is the SolidSafe Air. You get:

  • 5,000mAh battery capacity
  • Ultra-thin 6.8mm body
  • Qi2 wireless charging up to 15W
  • USB-C output up to 20W
  • Can charge two devices simultaneously

I own three of these batteries, and I always carry one with me wherever I go. My iPhone 17 Pro doesn't have enough battery life to last a full day, so having one of these in my everyday carry is essential. They're not only lightweight, but they also look and feel premium, and come in some pretty nice colors.

The SolidSafe Air 5K retails for US$59 on the BMX website, in three colors: black, silver, and gold. You can also pick up a two-pack or three-pack to save a bit of money. My only ask for the next generation is to swap the LED indicator for a small display, as long as it doesn't add to the thickness.

This is a pretty interesting product for iPhone photography enthusiasts, and for anyone who wants good lighting without carrying around a bulky setup. The SnapPocket is a small, lightweight ring light that magnetically attaches to the back of your phone. It can also flip around so you get great illumination when using the front-facing camera as well. You get:

  • 8 built-in LED lights
  • Brightness up to 90 lumens
  • Four adjustable brightness levels
  • Flip-around, MagSafe-compatible design
  • Built-in battery with USB-C charging

On paper, the SnapPocket is twice as bright as the iPhone's built-in flash, and it delivers a much more consistent light source, which is especially great for video. Like the other accessories featured in this roundup, portability and compactness are its main selling points. It fits in any pocket or bag, and since it's MagSafe compatible, you can even leave it attached to your phone.

The ShiftCam SnapPocket Light is available on Amazon for US$33 (after using the coupon on the product page). It comes in three colors: black, blue, and gray. It's the perfect gift for anyone looking to step up their iPhone photography without spending a fortune or overcomplicating things.

I've covered this product before, but I use it so frequently that I wanted to mention it again. We all know SSD prices are getting ridiculous, but buying an external SSD is still far more cost-effective than paying for additional built-in storage on your iPhone. So whenever I'm shooting ProRes video, I always use the Lexar ES5 SSD. It connects magnetically to the phone and has a built-in USB-C cable, allowing me to record video directly to the SSD without taking up any of the iPhone's internal storage. You get:

  • Read and write speeds up to 2,000MB/s
  • USB 3.2 Gen 2×2 connectivity support
  • ProRes direct recording up to 4K/120fps
  • IP65 protection rating, with 3-meter drop resistance
  • Up to 4TB capacity

Size is also why I prefer this SSD over others. It's small, thin, and the corners are slightly rounded, which makes it more comfortable to hold when you're gripping your phone.

The Lexar ES5 is available on Amazon, with the 1TB model starting from US$199. While the price is higher than it was a few months ago, it's still far cheaper than buying an iPhone with 1TB of built-in storage.

Wrap-up

As mentioned earlier, be sure to check out our video, where I'll be showcasing 11 thin and lightweight products that I know you readers will love. The five featured here are just a few of my absolute favorites. I've always been on a mission to minimize my everyday carry, and these accessories fit the bill perfectly. From the ultra-thin yet functional Snap Grip Stand, to the incredibly useful Lexar SSD, they all serve a purpose without forcing me to lug around large, heavy accessories.

What do you think of these products? Have you tried any of them before? What are your favorite accessories that fit into this category? Let's discuss in the comments below.
